changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO instruments (id, name, currency, asset_class, price_source, source_ref, created_at) SELECT '99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999915', 'Euros', 'EUR', 'CASH', 'MANUAL', 'EUR', now() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instruments WHERE price_source = 'MANUAL' AND source_ref = 'EUR');
